title: Understanding Codons and Amino Acids
text: Remember that each codon, a sequence of $$3$$ DNA letters, translates into an amino acid. There are $$64$$ possible codons but only $$20$$ amino acids. Think about how this relationship can help reduce the dimensionality of your data.

title: Compact Representation
text: Consider using the $$20$$ amino acids as your features instead of the $$64$$ codons. This will significantly reduce the number of features you need to work with.

title: Choosing the Right Dimensionality
text: If you encode using amino acids, what would be the dimensionality of your data?
